name: Methylenedioxynitazene
summary: Methylenedioxynitazene (3',4'-Methylenedioxynitazene) is a benzimidazole derivative which has been sold as a designer drug over the internet and presumably has opioid effects. It is an analogue of etonitazene where the benzyl ring is substituted with a 3,4-methylenedioxy ring system rather than an ethoxy group. It was first reported in the UK in early 2024.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it specifically. Nitazene opioids can cause deep sedation and dangerously slowed or stopped breathing, and many have been linked to overdose deaths, often in people who did not know they were taking them.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它本身所知甚少。尼他嗪類鴉片可能造成深度鎮靜，以及危險的呼吸減慢或停止，其中許多已與過量死亡有關，死者往往不知道自己用了它。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它本身所知甚少。尼他嗪类鸦片可能造成深度镇静，以及危险的呼吸减慢或停止，其中许多已与过量死亡有关，死者往往不知道自己用了它。

fact.en: It is a nitazene, part of a family of benzimidazole opioids first made by the Swiss company Ciba in the 1950s, some of which are far stronger than fentanyl.
fact.zh: 它屬於尼他嗪類，這個苯并咪唑鴉片家族最早由瑞士汽巴公司在1950年代合成，其中一些比吩坦尼強得多。
